newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 14.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on February 14. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Indonesian government supports the intention of two state-owned companies PT Aneka Tambang nickel company and PT Tambang Timah tin company to develop the huge Busang gold find in east Kalimantan.
Secretary-general of the National Commission of Human Rights Baharuddin Lopa said the ethnic conflict in West Kalimantan was likely to tread a long and winding road before reaching a settlement.
President Suharto will make a week-long visit to Cambodia, Laos and Burma on February 7. Suharto will make use of the visit to strengthen the trade and economic relations with the three countries.
Holiday makers are expected to return to Jakarta next week after spending about a week at their hometown to celebrate the Moslem Eid al-Fitr festivity.
Members of parliament have called for a stricter regulation on the distribution and production of liquors.
